PRODUCT UPDATE / OCTOBER 2026

LESS SEARCHING.
MORE CLARITY.

Your payment apps hold different parts of the story. PayDar brings supported receipts into one local record, with the details you need to review a payment.

01 / PAYMENTS

One receipt history.

Share a receipt, paste the text or import a CSV. Search by recipient and reference, filter by app and export your records.

02 / ACCOUNT

Your Google account.

Sign in from the Android Account tab. View your profile, sign out or delete your cloud account. Using the local tools never requires sign-in.

03 / CONTROL

Stored on your phone.

Choose the sources you import. Review, correct and delete records. Payment history does not sync between accounts or devices.

PRODUCT INFORMATION

FREQUENT
QUESTIONS.

Does PayDar make payments?

No. PayDar is a checking companion. You continue to make payments in your existing UPI app. PayDar never asks for your UPI PIN or bank password.

Does “not found” mean safe?

No. A local list can be incomplete or outdated. An unknown ID remains unverified. Always confirm the recipient independently, including the recipient name in your payment app.

What works in the Android beta?

QR decoding, local ID lookup, the MuleGuard questionnaire, recovery report creation, subscription tracking and unified transaction history. The Payments tab supports shared or pasted receipts, manual records and PayDar-format CSV. PayDar does not request SMS or notification access. Authoritative fraud feeds, physical QR tamper detection and on-device LLM inference are not active in this beta.

Does PayDar read SMS or notifications?

No. This build deliberately avoids SMS and notification permissions. Share a payment receipt from your payment app, paste its text, import a CSV or add the record manually. Your inbox and notifications remain outside PayDar.

Can it recover a wrong payment?

It helps you prepare a report and find official support channels. It cannot reverse a transaction, automatically submit a dispute, or guarantee a refund. Your payment provider or bank handles the case.

Is there an iPhone version?

This first version is built for Android. iPhone support is not available. SMS inbox access and some device features would require a different approach on iOS.
